hardware: Samsung S26 Ultra, Hexagon v81, device R5KL30G6MCX

implementation.dense_lut: Four distinct 16-entry int16 LUTs per 128-byte HVX vector; two output panels share table loads. K*16 bytes versus previous K*32. Unroll=1 selected after testing 2,4,8 and sequential panels; final dense GEMV disassembly has no stack spill.
implementation.offline_layout: Lossless QS2CX_WH code permutation to [K/32][N/128][8][128], K*N/4 bytes. Compact K-major rows DMA to lower half of existing expanded-pitch VTCM rows. Runtime repack bypassed.
implementation.reader: 64-byte versioned little-endian header with source offset, shape, byte counts and CRC32 of entire source and payload. Both validated on every expert cache load.
implementation.storage: Preserve original WH for prefill/fallback and append aligned prepared codes to each expert arena slot. Approximately twice cached code bytes, not twice entire model.
implementation.weight_semantics: 2-bit codes select four signed-int4 palette entries; no weight zero point added; no requantization.
implementation.activation_semantics: Existing affine uint8 activations unchanged. LUT entries int16; final accumulation int32. No int8 LUT quantization.

modes.7: dense LUT with offline codes; falls back to mode6 if registered experts lack prepared images

conditions.crc_validation: entire source and entire prepared payload on every expert cache load
conditions.offline_storage: original WH codes and prepared LUT codes both retained in each expert slot

end_to_end.aggregation: 64 tokens divided by mean generation wall time of two balanced-order runs per variant
end_to_end.limits: Two runs per variant; small dense-only change is within possible run variance. Same benchmark binaries and workload for all cells; raw temperatures and commands retained.

microbenchmark.conditions: 8 HVX workers, median of 3 runs, 200 passes per run after 3 warmups. No-DMA cases use prepared VTCM inputs. DMA cases serialize whole-matrix DMA and compute; production uses overlapped scheduling.

probe_modes.6: original LUT with runtime row repack
probe_modes.10: dense LUT with runtime row repack
probe_modes.11: dense offline K-major rows, no repack

microbenchmark.warning: Probe mode numbers differ from NNTR_HTP_QS2_GEMV environment modes. Microbenchmark excludes host file reads/checks and expert cache replacement.

interpretation: Dense tables halve LUT storage but GEMV alone is approximately 15-16% slower on these two shapes; no demonstrated standalone speedup.
Removing runtime repack reduces no-DMA total microbenchmark time by about 57-59%; serial-DMA totals improve about 28-39%. This is not an end-to-end TPS claim.

Combined offline implementation regresses full-model TPS by about 47%. It adds original plus prepared file reads, full CRC passes, allocation/copy and dual-layout arena memory on expert misses. These are plausible dominant costs, but their individual causal contributions were not separately profiled.

Before promoting offline mode, redesign loading to avoid two layout reads on every miss, amortize validation with a sound immutable-artifact lifetime, and measure prefill/decode/cache behavior together.

offline_tool_reader.result: pass; Python conversion roundtrip, independent C production packer, C++ reader, malformed/stale/truncated artifacts, real expert shapes

validation.device_kernel: 1440 exact cells per build: v81 nomatch VLUT and matching VLUT; 15 shape/palette cases, 1/4/6/8 workers, DMA off/on, 12 probe modes
validation.device_moe: Two MoE tests pass; additional poisoned-original-WH test proves mode7 reads prepared codes; prefill and cache rebind paths remain exact.
validation.offline_conversion: All 4864 source tensors independently roundtrip checked during export.
validation.build: Android ARM64 core/app and v81 DSP pass; kernel v79 -Wall -Werror cross compile pass (no v79 device test).
validation.excluded_attempts: Early export and extra MoE test attempts failed when another inference held DSP/VTCM resources. Idle retries passed; failed attempts excluded from reported performance.
validation.format: clang-format 14, current-task changed lines; no full platform CI matrix run.

usage: Run existing expert-cache CausalLM invocation with NNTR_HTP_QS2_EXPORT=1; capture stdout to experts.log.
Deploy the prepared_experts directory; use NNTR_HTP_QS2_VTCM=1 NNTR_HTP_QS2_GEMV=7 NNTR_HTP_QS2_PREPARED_DIR=/absolute/device/path/prepared_experts with the existing invocation.
For dense-only comparison use NNTR_HTP_QS2_GEMV=6 and unset NNTR_HTP_QS2_PREPARED_DIR.
build_source_note: Performance binaries precede an include-path-only fix in test/htp/nntr_hvx_mm_u8i4.c and final formatting; current-source compile also checked. No executable behavior changed by that fix.
